suite: the map (Map . Classic, the counts, the one selection on four surfaces, the view)
expect_red: [real] an anchor picked in the scene selects its feature's pin on the map

mutations.contract: A pin is keyed by its feature (part@node), which is what a scene pick resolves to.
mutations.note: Keys the pin by its node instead, so the feature's light never reaches it.
mutations.replace: register(reg, g, "map__pin" + tint, VA.FOCUS_KINDS.feature, pin.node); /* mutated: keyed by node, not feature */
